title: Saturday 140308
wodRaw:
[Workout 14.2](http://games.crossfit.com/workouts/the-open/2014#tabs-2)  
  
Every 3 minutes for as long as possible complete:

  
*From 0:00-3:00*

  
   2 rounds of:

  
   95-lb. overhead squats, 10 reps

  
   10 chest-to-bar pull-ups

  
*From 3:00-6:00*

  
   2 rounds of:

  
   95-lb. overhead squats, 12 reps

  
   12 chest-to-bar pull-ups

  
*From 6:00-9:00*

  
   2 rounds of:

  
   95-lb. overhead squats, 14 reps

  
   14 chest-to-bar pull-ups

  
Etc., following same pattern until you fail to complete both rounds.

  
  
Post rounds and reps completed to comments and/or register and submit your results as part of the [2014 Reebok CrossFit Games Open](http://games.crossfit.com/).  
  
Top male and female scores will receive $2,014.
